narr: A slow moving low pressure system tracked across Wisconsin during the afternoon hours on Thursday (8/1). Showers and thunderstorms developed in a very moist airmass leading to small hail, gusty winds, and very heavy rain along across portions of central Wisconsin. As much as 3 to 5 inches of rain fell across this region during the afternoon, causing flash flooding and road closures across portions of Marathon, Wood, and Waushara counties.
ev: Heavy rain caused flash flooding along Highway 13 and County V in northwestern Wood County.
Heavy rain caused flash flooding in Schofield and Rothschild in central Marathon County. Many roads were closed due to standing and flowing water.
Heavy rain caused flash flooding and a road closure at County V and state route 21 in western Waushara County.

County V flooded from County H to highway 10.
Multiple roads flooded across Lincoln Township just west of Marshfield. Roads flooded included; Lincoln, Ives, Sunset, McMillan and Veterans.
